background-repeat.title: <background-repeat>
background-repeat.history: Controls tiling of background images (repeat, no-repeat, repeat-x, repeat-y, space, round).

background-position.title: <background-position>
background-position.history: Sets initial position of background image (keywords, percentages, lengths).

background-size.title: <background-size>
background-size.history: Controls size of background images (cover, contain, or explicit sizes).

background-attachment.title: <background-attachment>
background-attachment.history: Determines whether background scrolls with content or is fixed to viewport (scroll, fixed, local).

background-origin.title: <background-origin>
background-origin.history: Specifies the box (border-box, padding-box, content-box) used to position/clip the background.
